semantic_reviews.finding: NASA explicitly describes Planet X / Planet Nine as theoretical and not yet discovered. Do not create a confirmed-body position or existence percentage from this page.
Pluto overview identifies a dwarf planet; provides educational context and links. The overview is not an epoch-specific 3D state vector or a SPHEREx image.

semantic_reviews.review_scope: table columns, uncertainty/reference and missing values
semantic_reviews.finding: Shared table gives satellite GM, mean radius and derived density with sigma/reference and n/a or upper limits. Copy any later selected field with its unit, uncertainty and original reference. It does not by itself supply a time-dependent 3D orbit.

semantic_reviews.review_scope: tool shell versus resolved object identity and field presence
semantic_reviews.finding: Static lookup HTML is a JavaScript tool shell. A default-TLS GET of the official SBDB JSON resolved 90377 Sedna (2003 VB12), with orbit epoch/element fields. No returned orbital/physical numeric values were adopted or validated for simulation.

semantic_reviews.review_scope: one conflicting historical year on source pages
semantic_reviews.finding: The Planet X overview contains a Pluto-reclassification sentence with 2016, while the Pluto overview states 2006. Do not copy that inconsistent sentence into product content. This inventory does not import those historical-year fields.

licensing_status: Per-asset or adopted-data usage terms and credits must be checked before importing assets/code/data; a source link is not NASA logo permission. No image/texture assets imported in this task.
implementation_order: AGENTS.md fixed order remains unchanged. Minimal 3D and Pluto-to-real-SPHEREx connection precede any expanded 57-body catalogue; conditional density and an individual hypothesis remain separate.
